title: Refactor einsum_optimizer to emit via template families
objective: Refactor `mechdsl.codegen.einsum_optimizer` so `plan_contraction` returns both a tier (scheduling) AND a template-family dispatch key (realisation). Backend printers look up the family in their own per-backend emission table.
scope: Extend `ContractionPlan` with a `family` field (enum from the P9-1 spec).
Populate the family in `plan_contraction` via pattern matching on the einsum string.
Each backend printer gets a `family_emitters: dict[Family, EmitterFunc]` lookup.
Refactor Taichi printer to route through the family emitters.
Gate the refactor behind a flag (default ON) so it can be rolled back quickly if regressions appear.
implementation_steps: Implement pattern matching to classify existing einsum strings.
Refactor Taichi printer to use family emitters.
Regenerate goldens — emitted source may change in whitespace but not in semantics.
Run the full fast suite + slow equivalence tests.
acceptance_criteria: All existing contractions classify into a family.
Taichi printer produces equivalent (perhaps whitespace-different) source before/after.
No semantic regressions (cross-backend equivalence from P8-3 still passes).

cases: All contractions classified into a family enum
Taichi emission numerically equivalent before/after refactor (slow)
MFEM emission textually equivalent modulo whitespace
MOOSE emission textually equivalent modulo whitespace

risks: A large refactor touches the entire codegen layer; regressions are hard to localize. Mitigation: keep the old tier-only path reachable via a feature flag during the refactor.

commands.command: uv run pytest -m 'not slow and not gpu' -q
commands.note: only pre-existing P9-1 spec-gap failure remains

completion_notes: ContractionResult/ContractionPlan extended with Family field; family is classified in optimize_contraction and threaded through _contraction_result_to_plan as enum .name (JSON-safe, default 'FALLBACK' for legacy bundles).

Three backend printers (Taichi, MFEM, MOOSE) gained family_emitters dispatch tables + _dispatch_family router gated by family_emitters_enabled() reading MECHDSL_FAMILY_EMITTERS env var (off: '0'/'false'/'no'/'off').

Dispatch call sites verified reachable on hot paths: Taichi 945/996/1067/1165, MFEM 471/493/590, MOOSE 445/471. Per-family emitter helpers are verbatim copies of legacy inline bodies, so flag-OFF is byte-identical to legacy path (cross-backend whitespace-normalised equivalence test passes for all three backends).

Gate B medium finding addressed: _dispatch_family now emits a DEBUG log (_logger.debug) when falling back to the legacy body, making silent-fallback collisions observable — closes the Phase 8 Gate B silent-failure pattern.
Goldens untouched (git diff HEAD -- packages/mechdsl-core/tests/golden/ is empty). No rename churn: optimize_contraction retains its name (not renamed to plan_contraction).
Fast suite: 1291 passed, 2 skipped, only pre-existing P9-1 spec-gap test failing (user-owned; awaiting §9 patch).
